name: neurosignal-titanium-orchestrator
description: Unified root orchestrator for the NeuroSignal Enterprise ecosystem.

scripts.install:all: concurrently "cd pdd-website/backend/express-server && npm install" "cd pdd-website/frontend && npm install"
scripts.launch:hub: concurrently --kill-others "cd pdd-website/backend/express-server && npm start" "cd pdd-website/frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.launch:app: concurrently --kill-others "cd pdd-app/backend/express-server && npm start" "cd pdd-app/frontend && npm run dev"
